def solve_problem():

    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}

    vars['Var_1'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=14.67, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_1')
    lin_expr += 9.05 * vars['Var_1']
    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=17.42, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 5.52 * vars['Var_2']

    lin_expr += 8.78 * vars['Var_5']
    vars['Var_6'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=13.69, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_6')

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MAXIMIZE)

    m.addConstr(4.02 * vars['Var_1'] + 4.59 * vars['Var_2'] + 0.29 * vars['Var_3'] + 2.7 * vars['Var_4'] + 4.74 * vars['Var_5'] + 5.44 * vars['Var_6'] <= 87.0, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(3.5 * vars['Var_0'] + 3.74 * vars['Var_1'] + 9.11 * vars['Var_2'] + 7.4 * vars['Var_4'] + 4.87 * vars['Var_6'] <= 168.69, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(5.53 * vars['Var_0'] + 2.41 * vars['Var_3'] + 0.71 * vars['Var_4'] + 7.13 * vars['Var_6'] <= 86.45, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(6.41 * vars['Var_0'] + 0.54 * vars['Var_1'] + 7.39 * vars['Var_2'] + 5.18 * vars['Var_3'] + 2.17 * vars['Var_4'] + 4.73 * vars['Var_5'] + 2.13 * vars['Var_6'] <= 143.18, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(0.26 * vars['Var_1'] + 2.12 * vars['Var_2'] + 5.38 * vars['Var_3'] + 1.13 * vars['Var_5'] + 9.05 * vars['Var_6'] <= 79.79, name='C6')
    m.addConstr(7.23 * vars['Var_0'] + 4.04 * vars['Var_4'] + 3.8 * vars['Var_5'] + 8.2 * vars['Var_6'] <= 112.91, name='C7')
    m.addConstr(8.7 * vars['Var_0'] + 7.19 * vars['Var_2'] <= 120.74, name='C8')
